name: ims-ai-desktop
description: IMS AI 智能化桌面端（Electron + Agent + MCP）

scripts.format: pnpm format:docs && pnpm --filter @ims/desktop format && pnpm format:contracts && pnpm format:agent && pnpm format:mcp
scripts.format:contracts: cd services/platform-contracts && uv run --no-sync --extra dev python -m contracts.quality fix
scripts.format:agent: cd services/platform-agent-service && uv run --no-sync --extra dev python -m app.quality fix
scripts.format:mcp: cd services/platform-mcp-server && uv run --no-sync --extra dev python -m platform_mcp.quality fix
scripts.check: pnpm check:docs && pnpm --filter @ims/desktop check && pnpm check:contracts && pnpm check:agent && pnpm check:mcp
scripts.check:contracts: cd services/platform-contracts && uv run --no-sync --extra dev python -m contracts.quality gate
scripts.check:agent: cd services/platform-agent-service && uv run --no-sync --extra dev python -m app.quality gate
scripts.check:mcp: cd services/platform-mcp-server && uv run --no-sync --extra dev python -m platform_mcp.quality all
scripts.test:contracts: cd services/platform-contracts && uv run --no-sync --extra dev python -m contracts.quality test
scripts.test:agent: cd services/platform-agent-service && uv run --no-sync --extra dev python -m app.quality test
